profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer - Data at JPMorganChase
profile.summary: Senior Data Engineer with 10+ years of experience building large-scale data platforms and model-adjacent systems in highly regulated enterprise environments (finance, healthcare). Specialized in data engineering for AI/ML workloads, including model-driven data pipelines, Apache Iceberg Lakehouse architectures, streaming systems, and LLM-enabled applications. Proven track record supporting production model workflows, ensuring data quality, reliability, and performance at scale, and collaborating closely with ML, risk, and analytics teams. Strong Python background with hands-on experience deploying containerized workloads on cloud-native infrastructure.

projects.title: AI FileOps Agent
projects.description: Developed an agentic AI personal assistant powered by Groq’s Llama‑3.3 and Gemini 2.5 to automate local file operations. Implemented custom tools for reading, writing, and directory management, enabling natural language interaction with the file system. Demonstrated practical applications of LLM orchestration, agent design patterns, and AI‑driven automation.

projects.title: EmbedOps — Production-Grade AI Data Engineering Platform
projects.description:
- Designed and implemented an end-to-end AI data pipeline for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), including document ingestion, text chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing.
- Built a batch embedding pipeline that processes PDFs into semantic vectors and metadata, storing embeddings in Pinecone and raw context in a versioned chunk store.
- Developed a FastAPI-based retrieval service supporting metadata-filtered semantic search and grounded context resolution.
- Implemented a clean RAG layer that consumes retrieved context and generates answers using a local LLM, ensuring no hallucination without source data.
- Containerized the entire system with Docker Compose, enabling one-command, cross-platform execution with no external LLM dependencies.

Tech: Python, FastAPI, SentenceTransformers, Pinecone, Docker, Vector Databases, RAG, Ollama
